fusion_named.formula: n_oracle_pass / n_matched, where n_matched is the matched-intersection size and an unattempted matched case counts as not-pass (failed arm never dropped from the comparison).
n_attempted / n_matched on the same matched intersection. Distinct from correctness: an arm can attempt every case and still fail them.
n_recovered / n_first_attempt_failures on matched cases, where recovered means first_attempt_oracle != pass and retry_oracle == pass. Uncomputable when n_first_attempt_failures == 0.
mean over attempted matched cases of 1 - min(1, (checkpoints + abort + budget_exhausted) / 4). Uncomputable when no matched case was attempted.

complement.formula: |solved(fusion) minus union(solved(sources))| / |corpus|. Material when delta >= 0.10 and at least one unique solve. Unique solves are NEVER added to the head-to-head composite.
